Description: Unique laboratory identifier assigned to each bacterial isolate.
Comments: Verified unique across all records (0 duplicates).

Description: Species of the bacterial isolate recovered from the clinical specimen.
Anatomical source / specimen type from which the isolate was recovered (body system: specimen).
Comments: Free-text categorical; hierarchical (system: specimen) — consider splitting into two fields.

Description: Country in which the isolate was collected.
Numeric code identifying the participating study/collection centre.
Sex of the patient from whom the isolate was collected (M/F).
Age of the patient in years at the time of specimen collection.
Comments: Contains a maximum value of 150 — implausible for a human age; flagged for review, not altered.

Description: Date on which the specimen was collected. Recorded inconsistently across records (full date, text date, or year only).
Comments: Mixed data types (datetime, text 'DD-Mon-YY', bare year int) — standardized in script 01.

Description: Beta-lactamase production status of the isolate, as determined by phenotypic testing (applicable mainly to H. influenzae).
Comments: Inconsistent coding: 'Negative'/'NEG' and 'Positive'/'POS' used interchangeably; ~54% missing (mostly not applicable outside H. influenzae).

Description: Minimum Inhibitory Concentration (mg/L) of Amoxicillin/Clavulanic acid against the isolate. Raw text field combining a dilution value with an optional censoring operator ('</=' = left-censored, '>' = right-censored).
Comments: MIC field; requires parsing into numeric value + censoring flag (see script 01).
